reuse.why: Edits the existing getScheduledAmount and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: Replaces the rule in its single definition and simplifies it to Math.min / subtraction; nothing is copied.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts, the one place the tree computes a planned schedule amount.

scope.why: Only the helper body, its comments and the matching tests change.

maintainability.why: The new rule is shorter and clearer than the old sign-based logic and is tested at the helper.

bypasses_abstraction.where: no caller re-implements the planned amount; all go through getScheduledAmount
